title: Find lines starting with a prefix in a sorted file
summary: Use the `look` command to quickly find lines in a sorted text file that start with a specific word or prefix. It is faster than `grep` for sorted files.

aliases.text: find lines starting with word in file
как найти строки с префиксом в файле

steps.explain: Run `look` followed by the prefix you want to find and the path to the sorted file. The file must be sorted for this to work correctly.

placeholders.name: PREFIX
placeholders.description: The beginning of the line you are searching for

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the sorted text file

steps.expect: Lines from the file that start with the specified prefix are displayed.

steps.explain: If you are searching for words in the system dictionary, you can omit the file path. `look` defaults to `/usr/share/dict/words` and assumes case-insensitive alphanumeric search.

placeholders.name: PREFIX
placeholders.description: The beginning of the word you are looking for

steps.expect: Dictionary words starting with the prefix are displayed.
